uploads.changelog:
siikk-Layer 1.3

- Group fix: anyone from your group who is visible nearby now always counts as on your layer – even if an old report says otherwise.
- After an invite the layer is measured twice (3 s and 20 s), old group reports are dropped and fresh ones requested.
- Reports are no longer lost when two come in quick succession; old reports expire after 5 minutes.

siikk-Info Bar 2.0

- XP bonuses: the sleeping bag now always lasts 2 hours, remaining time shown in hours (e.g. 1:45:00).
- Warlocks: Demon Armor / Demon Skin shows in the tooltip with 30 minutes and a warning 1 minute before it expires.
